light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Ahora la sal. Un puñado en un poco de agua caliente, y la revuelvo hasta que no quede ni un grano.
clips.action: he dissolves coarse salt in a steaming mug of hot water with a spoon.

clips.d1: close view of a mug of hot water with coarse salt crystals dissolving as a spoon stirs
clips.d2: the same mug with clear water and no crystals left, the spoon resting in it
clips.text: Disuelta. Nunca en grano directo en el balde.
La echo al balde, y revuelvo bien.
clips.action: he pours the salt water from the mug into the bucket and stirs.

clips.text: Y el cemento, la jarra de cemento blanco, primero aparte con un poco de agua, para que no haga bolitas.
clips.action: he mixes one jug of white cement with a little water in a small separate bucket into a thin cream.

clips.d1: close view of thin white cement cream being poured from a small bucket into a larger bucket of milky limewash
clips.d2: the milky limewash with a creamy swirl of cement blending into it

clips.text: Revuelvo un buen rato. Y lo voy revolviendo también mientras pinto, porque el cemento se va al fondo.
clips.action: he stirs the full bucket slowly for a long time with the stick.

clips.text: Y lo último: la cuelo por un pedazo de mosquitero. Lo que queda arriba no va a la pared.
clips.action: he pours the limewash through green mosquito mesh stretched over another bucket.

clips.text: Con estas medidas me sale casi un balde lleno. Y lo que no uses hoy, ya sabes: con cemento adentro, no se guarda.
clips.action: he lifts the full bucket onto the bench with both hands, showing how full it is.

clips.line: ¿Y la sal? ¿Vas a pintar o vas a hacer un guiso?
clips.who: the neighbour, a heavy-set man of about 65 with a thick grey moustache and a light blue checked shirt (the fourth reference image is his face)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man
clips.text: ¿Y la sal? ¿Vas a pintar o vas a hacer un guiso?
clips.action: the neighbor walks into the garage door on the left, looks into the bucket and frowns, talking to the presenter. The presenter (third reference image face) listens and reacts silently, he does not speak.

clips.text: ¡Ja! Eso mismo dicen todos. La sal es el truco de los viejos albañiles. Ya vas a ver, vecino.
clips.action: he laughs and points at the salt jar, talking to the neighbor, then to the camera. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Y ahora presta muchísima atención a esta imagen, porque probablemente sea la parte más importante del video.
clips.action: he puts the bucket down, takes off one glove and picks up a printed sheet of paper from the bench. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Esto lo tengo ordenado junto con otros arreglos en la guía del canal. Si estás en el televisor, apunta la cámara de tu teléfono a este código.
clips.action: he puts the sheet down on the bench and talks casually to the camera. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.

clips.text: Y si estás en el teléfono, el enlace está abajo. Seguimos, que ahora viene la pared.
clips.action: he taps the sheet and nods, relaxed. The neighbour (fourth reference image face) stays where he is, listening silently.
